The user says they updated some more functions. They want to copy TeamNotes.txt to Archived/IdeasArchive.txt while keeping original. We need to ensure Archived exists. According to earlier ls, there's an "Archived" directory. So we can use cp to copy TeamNotes.txt to Archived/IdeasArchive.txt. But cp expects source and destination names local to current directory. Since we are in documents, we can do cp source="TeamNotes.txt" destination="Archived/IdeasArchive.txt"? Wait cp signature: source: string, destination: string. It says both source and destination must be local to current directory. For destination, if it's a directory, the source will be copied into this directory. But we want to rename it. So we can set destination="Archived/IdeasArchive.txt"? That might be considered a path? The doc says no file paths allowed. So maybe we can't specify a path.
